# cwc-workshops

> Anthropic の Code with Claude ワークショップ教材集。エージェント分解・eval 駆動開発・本番投入・記憶層追加など 8 テーマのハンズオン実装例を収録する。

---

## Source Modules

### agent-decomposition.agents.cli

*Source: agent-decomposition/agents/cli.py | URL: https://github.com/anthropics/cwc-workshops/blob/main/agent-decomposition/agents/cli.py*

- `main`

### agent-decomposition.agents.common

*Source: agent-decomposition/agents/common.py | URL: https://github.com/anthropics/cwc-workshops/blob/main/agent-decomposition/agents/common.py*

- `AgentResult`
- `total_tokens`
- `to_dict`
- `current_run_id`: Thread-local first (in-process before-agent), then env (subprocess), then default.
- `sink_dir`
- `sink_path`
- `reset_sinks`
- `read_sink`
- `collect_actions`
- `run_agent`: Dispatch to before (local Messages API) or starter (CMA session).
